title: Verification
subtitle: Earn the verified badge — reviewed by a real person, same flow as the app.

gate.title: Get verified. Build trust.
gate.body: The verified badge tells hosts a real person and a real business are behind your profile. Applying is included with Pro and Premium plans — approval is always reviewed by our team.

identity.title: Identity ✦
identity.hint: Your legal details stay private — only used to verify your identity.
identity.idFrontOnFile: On file from your last submission

business.title: Business ✦
business.name: Business / Display name
business.proofHint: Insurance certificate, business license, or registration — images or PDFs.

next: What happens next? We'll review your information within 1–3 business days. You'll be notified in the app and here once a decision has been made. By submitting, you agree to Vendora's Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.

status.approvedBody: Your verified badge is live on your public profile — hosts browsing Vendora see it next to your name.
status.needsInfoBody: We need additional information before we can approve your request.
status.rejectedBody: Reach out to support if you think this was a mistake.
status.reviewBody: Your request is being reviewed. This usually takes 1–3 business days — we'll notify you the moment a decision is made.

toast.namesRequired: Legal name and business name are required.
toast.idRequired: A photo of the front of your government ID is required.
toast.docRequired: Add at least one proof document — insurance, license, or registration.
toast.submitted: Submitted — we'll review within 1–3 business days.

manager.title: Verifications
manager.intro: Optional but recommended. Verified vendors get badges on their profile, rank higher in search, and unlock the hosts who filter by verification level. Documents are stored privately — only admin reviewers can open them.

identity.label: Identity
identity.blurb: Government-issued photo ID. Confirms you are who you say you are. We blur the photo and store the file privately — only admin reviewers can open it.

insurance.label: Liability insurance
insurance.blurb: A current certificate of insurance ($1M+ general liability is standard). Required by most premium venues and a strong trust signal for hosts.

business_license.label: Business license
business_license.blurb: Your business registration, tax ID, or local trade license. Confirms you operate as a legitimate business.

background_check.label: Background check
background_check.blurb: Upload a recent background check report (Checkr, Sterling, GoodHire — anything dated within the last 12 months). Critical for vendors who work in private homes (photographers, planners, makeup artists, in-home chefs).

toast.fileType: Use JPG, PNG, WEBP, or PDF
